title: Local lifts for Frobenius minus identity
statement: Let p be prime, S a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme over F_p [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], E a finite locally free O_S-module [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module], and F an additive endomorphism of its lifted tensor-section etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] satisfying F(as)=a^p F(s) on every etale object. Then F-1 is locally surjective: every section over an etale object lifts after an etale covering of that object.

proof.text: Given a section over U and a point x, take an affine coordinate neighbourhood A supplied by the local-coordinate lemma. Restrict the section and call its tuple b. Apply the affine polynomial solution-cover theorem with this matrix and tuple. The resulting etale map P→A is surjective.

Use the inverse coordinate equivalence on P to turn the universal tuple into a section t. The matrix formula identifies (F-1)t with the restricted target tuple. Naturality of coordinates identifies that tuple with the restriction of the given section. The composite P→A→U therefore belongs to its image sieve and covers x. The pointwise criterion for the small-etale topology proves local surjectivity.

lean.statement:
theorem frobenius_vectorBundle_local_lifts
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (S : Scheme.{u})
    [S.Over (Spec (.of (ULift.{u} (ZMod p))))] [CompactSpace S] [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (E : S.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    (F : (sheafCompose S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
        (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf E) ⟶
      (sheafCompose S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
        (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf E))
    (hF : ∀ (U : S.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : ULift.{u + 1} Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
        (e : ULift.{u + 1} Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.unop.hom).obj E, ⊤)),
      F.hom.app U (ULift.up (a.down • e.down)) =
        ULift.up (a.down ^ p • (@id Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.unop.hom).obj E, ⊤)
          (F.hom.app U e).down))) :
    Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective (F - 𝟙 _)
